messages:
sarah: Heads-up: I want to run the orders.created_at backfill + index job during the Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Plan: create index CONCURRENTLY, start async backfill workers in canary, then rollout. Need deploybot scheduled and a manual holdpoint after index validate. Risk: long-running backfill -> replica lag. Opinions?

deploy-bot: deploybot created job dbm-20260324-01 (tentative). Window: 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z-04:00:00Z. Canary: us-east-1. Steps: preflight -> create-index -> validate -> backfill-canary -> monitor -> rollout -> cleanup. Holdpoint set at "post-index-validate" waiting manual continue.

leo: +1 for CONCURRENTLY to avoid locks. Suggest canary only on single tenant shard (shard_id=23) first. Also add a replication-lag gate: abort backfill if >30s for >5min.

sarah: agree. Index DDL I'll run as: ```sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_createdat_null ON orders (created_at) WHERE created_at IS NULL;
```
Backfill will be the migration-worker v2.14.3 with feature-flag `backfill-run` which will be OFF by default. We'll flip it only after index validate and smoke checks.

tim: oncall check: add an automated watcher that posts to thread if replica_lag > 20s. If lag spikes, we should pause workers automatically. How do we pause them?

oncall-ana: we have two hatches: 1) feature-flag flip -> OFF will stop additional jobs from starting, 2) ability to pause SQS queue by setting policy to PauseConsumers. I'll add the exact commands to runbook. Also: if post-index row count diff >2% we abort.

sarah: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/dbm-20260324-backfill-runbook (draft). Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/notes/2026-03-24-backfill. I've added the manual validation checklist under the runbook (sample queries + thresholds).

leo: small snippet to kick deploybot (internal command): ```bash
/deploy schedule dbm-20260324-01 --when 2026-03-24T02:00Z --canary=us-east-1 --steps=preflight,create-index,validate,backfill-canary,rollout --holdpoint=post-index-validate
```

deploy-bot: holdpoint created: post-index-validate for dbm-20260324-01. To continue after checks: `/deploy continue dbm-20260324-01`. To abort: `/deploy abort dbm-20260324-01`. I will post automated metrics at each step.

oncall-ana: I'll be oncall that window and will watch the thread. Tim, can you ensure the lag alert copies here? If we see a sustained >20s we should `/deploy abort` and flip `backfill-run` off.

tim: will add a Prometheus alert — query: `max_over_time(replica_lag_seconds[5m]) > 20` notify #eng-sre and post here. Also adding a mute window for noisy alerts during preflight.

sarah: smoke tests to run during holdpoint: 1) zero errors in migration-worker logs for 10m, 2) sample query counts for created_at nulls match expected (within 2%), 3) no long GC pauses on primary. If pass -> leo or I will `/deploy continue`. If fail -> `/deploy abort` and we flip ff off.

leo: one more: pin web service image to tag `web@sha256:abc123` during backfill to avoid accidental schema+code mismatch. Add note in release notes to call out the pinned versions.

sarah: done. I've added the pinned versions and the rollback playbook to the runbook. Rollback path: 1) abort deploybot -> 2) flip `backfill-run` false -> 3) pause queue consumers -> 4) run quick cleanup: VACUUM and cancel long queries.

oncall-ana: copying eng-sre and product for visibility: @eng-sre @product. Also I'll be ready to trigger hotpatch if we need to restore behaviour for a tenant.

leo: :thumbsup: good to go from infra side.

sarah: will schedule final at 02:00 UTC Tue. Leaving the holdpoint in place. Tagging this thread with runbook and release note links. Thanks all.
